parsed.rationale: There is a narrow-complex tachycardia at about 150 bpm, and V1–V3 show tall, wide R/rSR' complexes with secondary ST depression and T-wave inversion; together with the slurred S waves in I and V6 this points to right bundle branch block rather than a normal ECG, and there is no ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
